notes:
Summary: mid-market analytics platform (customer-facing insights + search). Piloting LLM features to power conversational insights and result reranking. Evaluating Hosted API first; moving to Dedicated POC for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

Discovery timeline:
- 2026-01-28: Intro call (Jordan + Priya). High-level requirements captured: p99 latency target ~<400ms for chat, throughput 60 qps for embeddings batch jobs.
- 2026-02-05: Security questionnaire submitted; SOC2 + KMS required.
- 2026-02-15: Deep-dive demo (ff_20260215_002). Showed hosted API, streaming, and routing options. Customer liked prefix caching idea.
- 2026-02-26: Pricing follow-up; sent tiered commitment options and Dedicated sizing doc (drive/pricing-deck-parallax-v2.pdf).
- 2026-03-02: POC scoping call (ff_20260302_008). Agreed to 6-week Dedicated POC: canary rollout of model variants, region failover tests, rollback criteria.

POC requirements & scope:
- Objective: validate Dedicated latency, cost, and deterministic tail behavior for production chat + reranking pipeline.
- Workloads: real-time chat (p99 <400ms), batched embeddings nightly (~10k docs job), reranking for search results (99% within SLO).
- Model preferences: start with open-weights medium variant (quantized), fallback to hosted small model for overload scenarios, eventual plan to test newer variants from Redwood model catalog.
- Routing plan: canary rollout to 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% over 2 weeks. Canary to run in us-east-1.
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to hosted small model if Dedicated error rate >0.8% or p95 latency >600ms for >5 minutes; region failover route to eu-west-1 for residency traffic and as failover for us-east-1.
- Rollback criteria: sustained latency increase >20% vs baseline OR error-rate above threshold OR quality regressions detected by eval suite. Rollback plan owned by Parallax SRE + Redwood SE.

- VPC peering window needed: 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-22 for connectivity tests.
- IAM / KMS: require customer-managed key for embedding storage encryption.
- Tracing: will send sample traces to Redwood tracing endpoint; need sampling policy document.
- Test artifacts: provided a 150-query prompt set and 2k doc corpus for reranking evals.

Commercials & procurement:

- Budget: discussed $100k–$250k ARR band; finance needs line-item approval.
